$comment: Trips & Events (travel mode): the start and dates sheets, earlier purchases, payments outside the budget, Settings → Trips & Events, one trip's or event's screen and its card. `kind` is "trip" or "event" (budgets.kind); `name` is its tag's name, which is user data.

untitled.note: Shown as a trip's or event's name when its tag no longer exists.

error.running: A trip or an event is already on. End it first.
error.notFound: This trip or event no longer exists.

spent.note: Part of the one-line trip summary: "Lisbon · 420 of 900 EUR · day 3 of 7".

day.note: Part of the one-line trip summary.

dayOf.note: Part of the one-line trip summary.

dayPlanned.note: A trip that has outrun its planned last day; date is "22 Sep".

span.note: A past trip; from/to are "3 Jul 2026".

leftToday.note: Next to a big amount on the last day.

perDayLeft.message: a day for the {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
perDayLeft.note: Next to a big amount: what each remaining day may cost.

outside.note: Payments of the trip chosen to stay out of its budget.

label.note: VoiceOver label of the card's head.

pace.note: Spending per day against the planned pace.

unconverted.note: amounts is a list like "12.00 THB, 5.00 USD".

card.showSpent: Show what it was spent on
card.hideSpent: Hide what it was spent on

categoryLabel.note: VoiceOver; name is a category, trip the trip's or event's name.

start.title: {kind, select, event {New event} other {Travel mode}}

pastTitle.message: {kind, select, event {A past event} other {A past travel}}
pastTitle.note: Title when recording one that already happened.

start.subtitle: {kind, select, event {Every new expense gets the event’s tag; its budget counts everything with it, and none of it touches your monthly budgets.} other {Every new expense gets the travel tag; the budget counts everything with it, whatever currency it was paid in.}}
start.pastSubtitle: Name it and say what it was meant to cost; its purchases come next.

where.message: {kind, select, event {What’s the occasion?} other {Where to?}}
where.note: Placeholder of the name (for a trip, when no city is known).

wherePast.message: {kind, select, event {What was the occasion?} other {Where did you go?}}

start.nameLabel: {kind, select, event {What the event is} other {Where you are going}}
start.nameLabelPast: {kind, select, event {What the event was} other {Where you went}}

noRateBody.message: Payments from your {home} accounts could not be counted towards a {currency} budget. Keep it in {home} instead?

start.startFailed: {kind, select, event {Could not start the event} other {Could not start travel mode}}

dates.title: {kind, select, event {Event dates} other {Travel dates}}
dates.hint: Tap the first day, then the last. It can start today at the latest, and end whenever you like.
dates.hintPast: Tap the first day, then the last.

hintEvent.message: Tap the day. Tap a later one to make it longer.
hintEvent.note: Calendar hint for an event: one tap is a one-day event.

dates.tapLastCalendar: Tap the last day on the calendar
dates.start: {kind, select, event {Tap to start the event} other {Tap to start travel mode}}

whatWasName.note: A past one: which of those days' expenses were part of it.

backfill.hint: {kind, select, event {Tickets, a cake or decorations bought beforehand: tick them and they belong to the event. You can add the tag to anything later too.} other {Flights, hotels or tickets bought before leaving: tick them and they belong to the trip. You can add the tag to anything later too.}}
backfill.hintPast: {kind, select, event {The expenses from those days. Tick the ones that were the event.} other {The expenses from those days. Tick the ones that were the trip.}}
backfill.addTo: {kind, select, event {Tap to add to the event} other {Tap to add to the travel}}
backfill.tick: Tick the ones that belong to it

outside.title: Outside the budget
outside.hint: {kind, select, event {Tick what the budget was not meant for — a gift bought weeks ago, say. It is still part of the event, just not of its budget.} other {Tick what the budget was not meant for — the flights booked months ago, say. It is still part of the trip, just not of its budget.}}

count.note: Number of payments kept outside the budget.

settings.title: Trips & Events

noteShort.message: While a trip or an event is on, new expenses get its tag and count towards its budget.
noteShort.note: Note on the Trips & Events screen; the ⓘ unfolds noteMore.

noteMore.message: In any currency. None of it touches your monthly budgets.

now.note: Section header above the trip that is running.

settings.startHint: Where, how much, and the dates
settings.startEventHint: A birthday, a wedding, a night out
settings.addPast: Add a past trip or event
settings.addPastHint: Something that already happened, and what it cost

trip.noRateBody: Connect to the internet once, or keep the budget in its currency.

endTitle.message: {kind, select, event {End {name}?} other {End travel mode for {name}?}}

endBody.message: {line}. New expenses stop getting the “{name}” tag; it stays here as history.

trip.keep: {kind, select, event {Keep it on} other {Keep travelling}}
trip.removeBody: {kind, select, event {Only the event’s budget goes. The tag and every transaction with it stay.} other {Only the travel budget goes. The tag and every transaction with it stay.}}

currencyHint.message: {currency} · payments in any currency are converted

trip.addPurchasesHint: {kind, select, event {Tickets, a cake, decorations bought beforehand} other {Flights, hotels, tickets bought beforehand}}
trip.addPurchasesPast: Pick the ones from those days
trip.outsideHint: {kind, select, event {Paid for the event but not from its budget — a gift bought weeks ago, say. Choose them one by one.} other {Paid for the trip but not from its budget — the flights booked months ago, say. Choose them one by one.}}
trip.end: {kind, select, event {End the event} other {End travel mode}}
trip.endHint: New expenses stop getting its tag
trip.removeThis: {kind, select, event {Remove this event} other {Remove this travel}}

trip.note: Segment on the start sheet: what is being started. Short.

event.note: Segment on the start sheet: a party, a wedding, a day out. Short.
